top_signal.title: Has anyone started a furniture consultancy business? Looking for advice
top_signal.summary: I’m exploring the idea of starting a business within the furniture and interiors industry and would love to hear from anyone with experience in this area.  I’ve spent several years working in furniture retail and showrooms, particularly in sofas, furniture, fabrics and interiors.   I’ve realised that the part of my work I enjoy most is understanding products, materials, fabrics and construction, comparing different brands and helping customers make informed decisions.  I’m interested in whether there could be a business opportunity in offering independent furniture consultancy services.   For example:  Helping customers choose furniture for their homes.  Advising on fabrics, materials, quality and durability.  Comparing furniture brands and products.  Sourcing furniture based on customers’ budgets and requirements.  Offering independent advice without being tied to one retailer.   I’d be interested to know:  Does this sound like a viable business idea?  Are there already many businesses doing this?  Would customers actually pay for independent furniture advice?   What experience, qualifications or knowledge would you need to get started?  Has anyone here started something similar?  I’m still at the research stage, so I’d really appreciate  honest opinions, experiences and advice.   Thanks!       submitted by     /u/PurpleWinterRain1       [link]       [comments]
